title: Most common apps
hints: Count how many devices have each app: loop over installs.values(), and inside loop over set(apps) so each app counts once per device.
sorted(counts.items(), key=...) with a key that returns a tuple sorts by the first element, then the second.
The key (-count, name) sorts counts descending and names ascending at once; then slice [:k]. Handle k <= 0 before any of that.
